newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila's PHIBOR mostly lower as spot rates fall.
newsitem.headline: Manila's PHIBOR mostly lower as spot rates fall.

text.p: The Philippine interbank offered rates (PHIBOR) were mostly lower as spot short-term rates fell following the Central Bank's 25-basis point reduction in its overnight borrowing rate, traders said.
"The PHIBOR were just reacting to the Central Bank rate cut," one trader said. The overnight peso rate slipped to 10.3125 percent from 10.53125 percent last Friday.
However, banks remained cautious on the longer-term PHIBOR, waiting for the results of the Treasury bill auction later in the day, before adjusting their rates, he added.
